_how_to: Add one object per partner school to 'schools'. Fields: name (required), city, state, logo (e.g. /assets/partners/school.png), website (https://…), since, grades, students (how many take part, e.g. "300+"), verticals (list), note, gallery (an event slug from events.json, adds a 'See the photos' link). Leave out any field you don't want shown. Example: {"name":"Example School","city":"Pune","state":"Maharashtra","logo":"/assets/partners/example.png","since":"2026","grades":"Grades 6 to 9","verticals":["Communication","Leadership"],"note":"One line about the partnership.","gallery":"example-event"}
